response.rationale: Both D3 and D10 represent the same diagnosis of Cirrhosis. D3 is slightly more comprehensive in its support items, including the specific hepatitis C nucleic acid amplification test result, which D10 does not explicitly list as a support item, although it is present in the vignette.
